title: The Format is the Filter: Scoring Format Fixes What an LLM Judge Can Express
abstract: arXiv:2610.17158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When an LLM judge filters instruction-tuning data, its scoring format (binary verdict, 1--5 rating, 0--100 score, or comparison) is rarely justified or ablated. Holding the candidate pool, judge prompt, decoding and selection budget fixed, we score 15,406 UltraFeedback candidates under five formats with three judges, curate, fine-tune 66 models, and evaluate them with four judges. A 0--100 scale is worth only 7--12 equally used levels, two to three times a 1--5 scale rather than twenty, and a binary verdict leaves the top score tied in 77--78\% of prompts, so most selections are made at random. These properties are set by the format almost independently of the judge. Kendall's $\tau_b$ hides them: it ranks binary best while $\tau_a$ and top-1 agreement rank it last, because it discounts the ties a selector must break at random. translated_title: 格式即过滤器：评分格式决定了LLM裁判所能表达的内容
translated_abstract: 当LLM裁判过滤指令微调数据时，其评分格式（二元判定、1-5评分、0-100分数或比较式评分）很少被论证或消融验证。在保持候选池、裁判提示词、解码和选择预算不变的情况下，我们用三种裁判在五种格式下对15,406条UltraFeedback候选数据进行评分，据此筛选数据，微调66个模型，并用四种裁判进行评估。研究发现：0-100分制实际上只等效于7-12个被均匀使用的等级，仅为1-5分制的两到三倍而非二十倍；而二元判定使得77-78%的提示中最高分出现并列，因此大多数选择是随机做出的。这些特性由评分格式本身决定，几乎与所使用的裁判无关。Kendall's τ_b会掩盖这些问题：它将二元格式排名第一，而τ_a和top-1一致性却将其排在最后，因为该指标忽略了选择器必须随机打破的并列情况。两种比较式格式都继承了位置偏差，且偏差方向在不同裁判之间存在差异。在下游任务中，精选数据优于随机（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: LLM裁判的评分格式而非裁判本身决定了指令数据筛选的质量——0-100分制实际只等效7-12个等级，二元判定导致77-78%的并列需随机打破，且常用的Kendall's τ_b指标会掩盖这些问题。
en_tdlr: The scoring format of an LLM judge, not the judge itself, determines instruction data filtering quality: a 0-100 scale effectively offers only 7-12 usable levels, binary verdicts force random tie-breaking in 77-78% of prompts, and Kendall's τ_b masks these limitations.
